name: Spell preparation and optional Open Spell Access

dailySpellPreparation.rule: A spellcaster does not select a daily prepared subset of spells they are otherwise allowed to know or access.

openSpellAccess.whenEnabled: A spellcaster can cast any spell or cantrip on that character's own eligible class spell list at a spell level the class grants, without separately learning, recording or selecting that spell.
openSpellAccess.whenDisabled: Finite native spells-known progressions and class-specific eligible full-list entitlements still apply; daily preparation remains eliminated.

resourceSeparation.casting: Spell slots and optional spell points are alternative spell expenditure profiles, not additive resources.
resourceSeparation.classResources: Sorcery Points and other class-specific feature resources remain separately tracked.

unresolved: Shared spell-point runtime integration and class-specific source conversion exceptions.
